A '''battle''' on [[Ketal]] took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. An unique ID number on a particular [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] shipment allowed the [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra bacta-harvesting corporation]] to uncover a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel base (Ketal)|base]] on Ketal. Xucphra promptly informed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who eliminated the base.
